import os

path = '/tmp/start_replicated_kv.sh'
print("exists:", os.path.exists(path))
print("isdir:", os.path.isdir(path) if os.path.exists(path) else None)

print("\nAll entries in /tmp:")
for e in sorted(os.listdir('/tmp')):
    p = os.path.join('/tmp', e)
    kind = 'dir ' if os.path.isdir(p) else 'file'
    size = '' if os.path.isdir(p) else f" ({os.path.getsize(p)} bytes)"
    print(f" - [{kind}] {e}{size}")
